item.title: 4 men rescued after drifting on inflatable mattress in Sea of Galilee; two treated for dehydration
item.description:
Four men who drifted on the Sea of Galilee while on an inflatable mattress were rescued by Magen David Adom teams. Two of them suffered from dehydration and received initial fluid treatment aboard an MDA intensive care boat. After their condition improved, they did not require evacuation to a hospital.
MDA said that a passerby who was engaged in water sports spotted the incident and alerted the emergency teams.

item.title: United Airlines expected to resume flights to Israel
item.description:
US airline United Airlines is expected to resume its flights to Israel on September 8, operating an extensive schedule of two daily flights on the Newark-Tel Aviv route.
United Airlines' first flight will depart from Newark to Ben Gurion Airport on September 8. The following day, September 9, the first return flight will depart from Ben Gurion Airport back to Newark.

item.title: School shooting in Thailand: At least 10 students wounded, police suspect shooter is a student
item.description:
An active shooting incident took place at a school in the Bang Kruai district of Nonthaburi province, Thailand, north of the capital Bangkok.
According to a report by AFP, at least 10 students were wounded during the incident. Local police suspect the shooter is a student at the school. Authorities confirmed there were casualties, but further details regarding the victims' identities and the circumstances surrounding the shooting have not yet been released.
